title: 跨境电商 AI 技能库
title_en: Cross border e-commerce AI skill library
summary:
58 项业务技能　8 项辅助工具

Cross-border Ecommerce Skills 是一套面向跨境电商工作的 AI 技能库。它将常见业务任务整理为可供 AI 读取的流程，说明需要准备哪些资料、如何开展分析，以及应当交付什么结果，适合希望把 AI 用到具体工作中的卖家、运营人员和品牌团队。

可以用它做什么

商品与广告　从候选产品筛选、关键词研究到商品文案和上架检查，也能结合真实广告报表，整理问题与调整建议。

品牌与增长　规划品牌定位、新品推广、独立站优化、社媒内容、达人合作和渠道拓展，将分散想法变成可讨论的工作方案。

经营与协作　梳理落地成本、单品利润与现金流，把分析成果整理成报告、图表或团队知识库，便于复核和后续使用。
summary_en:
Cross border E-commerce Skills is an AI skill library designed for cross-border e-commerce work. It organizes common business tasks into AI readable processes, explaining what materials need to be prepared, how to conduct analysis, and what results should be delivered, suitable for sellers, operators, and brand teams who want to use AI in specific work.
What can be done with it
From candidate product screening and keyword research to product copy and listing inspection, products and advertisements can also be combined with real advertising reports to organize problems and adjustment suggestions.
Brand and Growth Planning: Brand positioning, new product promotion, independent website optimization, social media content, influencer collaboration, and channel expansion, turning dispersed ideas into negotiable work plans.
Sort out the landing costs, individual product profits, and cash flows through management and collaboration, and organize the analysis results into reports, charts, or team knowledge bases for easy review and subsequent use.

title: FDE小团队企业AI服务经验总结
title_en: FDE Small Team Enterprise AI Services
summary:
FDE 小团队如何从 0 到 1 做企业 AI 服务

从获客 初筛 现场调研 到报价 SOW 交付 验收的完整链路拆解

这是一份关于企业 AI 落地的实战复盘。客户从哪里来、怎样筛选、什么时候报价、为什么必须进场、SOW 怎么写、什么技术不要碰、测试集怎么做、需求变更怎么处理，以及怎样避免做完以后收不到钱。

它的核心判断只有一句：小团队卖的不是 AI，而是一个能够验收的结果。技术开发只是中间很小的一段，前后的客户判断、范围管理、测试验收和商业关系，才决定能不能收回钱、能不能获得下一次信任。
summary_en:
How FDE small teams can provide enterprise AI services from 0 to 1
Complete dismantling of the entire process from on-site customer screening research to SOW delivery and acceptance of quotation
This is a practical review of the implementation of enterprise AI. Where do customers come from, how to screen, when to quote, why they must enter the site, how to write SOW, what technologies should not be touched, how to make test sets, how to handle requirement changes, and how to avoid not receiving payment after completion.
Its core judgment is only one sentence: the small team is not selling AI, but a result that can be accepted. Technical development is just a small part in the middle, where customer judgment, scope management, testing and acceptance, and business relationships determine whether the money can be recovered and whether the next trust can be gained.

title: Codex PPT 制作工具与工作流指南
title_en: Codex PPT Production Tool and Workflow Guide
summary:
Codex PPT 制作工具与工作流指南

按演讲 交付 科普 修改和长期工作台选择方案

这份指南基于 Miles Ma 的 PPT 工具合集重新整理。重点不是罗列更多工具，而是先判断演示的使用方式和交付格式，再选择制作路径。

核心判断是：自己播放和交 PDF，可以优先使用网页演示；客户需要继续修改，就要优先保证文字、图表和数据可编辑；视觉型课件可以使用整页生图，但修改成本更高。
summary_en:
Codex PPT Production Tool and Workflow Guide
Deliver popular science modifications and long-term workbench selection plans based on speeches
This guide is reorganized based on Miles Ma's PPT tool collection. The key is not to list more tools, but to first determine the usage and delivery format of the demonstration, and then choose the production path.
The core judgment is that playing and submitting PDFs by oneself can give priority to using web presentations; If the customer needs to continue modifying, priority should be given to ensuring that the text, charts, and data are editable; Visual courseware can use full page illustrations, but the cost of modification is higher.
